changelog.title: A new Home, and any Roblox version
sections: New
Home is rebuilt: the game you played last up top, then Continue playing, Favorites and Popular now in tidy grids, with "Show all" instead of arrow rows.
Your friends are always on the right of Home: who's in a game (with Join), who's online, and offline folded away.
Popular now switches between Roblox's lists (Top Trending, Up-and-Coming and more) with one click.
Choose a version in Settings > Deployment: install any Roblox version your version archive saved, with the day Roblox released it.
A Back button on game, profile and item pages.
Settings > About, with the Discord server and credits.
Improved
The bottom dock names each button when you point at it.
Saved avatars open in 3D much faster.
Clicking an item in your avatar inventory opens its page.
Head shapes are listed by name under your avatar instead of covering it.
The favorite button sits next to Play, and the quick-join buttons say what they do.
Pages that need an account have a Log in button, and the dock shows one when you're logged out.
Fixed
Fewest players now really shows the emptiest servers, and Join least full joins one.
Friends no longer show up without a name.
Head shapes all showed the head you're wearing.
Saved outfits Roblox has no picture of show a grey stand-in instead of nothing.

changelog.title: A new way to sign in
sections: New
Signing in now happens inside HuiClient, on a full-window screen instead of a separate Roblox window.
Quick Log In: sign in with a code you confirm on your phone, no password needed.
A short welcome after you sign in.
Find players remembers the players you open, under Recent searches.
Saved avatars on every profile: see the avatars a player saved, each in 3D with its items and prices.
